column2: - [Wikipedia, Signs of AI writing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Signs_of_AI_writing): a descriptive catalog of recurring patterns, not a reliable test of authorship or a universal style code. Its revision of 2026-11-19 moves em-dash overuse to "Historical indicators," because newer models are tuned to avoid the em dash and the resulting lack of punctuation variety "has become its own sign." [sloptells](https://sloptells.com) is a dated catalog of tells, measured against matched human writing in social and forum registers. It also lists the em dash as a myth, and names uniform sentence cadence as the current rhythm tell. The skill keeps its em-dash ban as a preference, and its rule on sentence length asks for variety that follows the content.
